prompts.purpose: Force task routing to state objective, route, profile, skills, MCP sensors, quality gates, and next action before execution.
failure_modes: tool-first execution without route
profile selection omitted
quality gate omitted
evaluation_notes: Route output should be inspectable before high-risk work.
A route card that cannot name its gates is treated as incomplete.

prompts.purpose: Put each selected agent's control objectives, controlled variables, feedback signals, stability metrics, and rollback policy into its context packet.
failure_modes: agent runs without control objective
reviewer receives no rollback policy
subagent output cannot be tied back to the governance kernel
evaluation_notes: Generated context packets must include a Control Bindings section.

prompts.purpose: Block formal references unless author, year, title, source, verification basis, verification status, and verification source are recorded. DOI must be verified when present in evidence; user-provided sources, complete paper PDFs, and public academic index records can waive the must-have-DOI requirement.
failure_modes: citation gate marked pass without report
reference has neither verified DOI nor approved DOI-waiver evidence
local source evidence promoted into formal bibliography without PDF or source verification
evaluation_notes: validate_research_pipeline checks the report path and pass semantics.
User-provided sources, complete paper PDFs, and public academic index records can support a documented DOI waiver; public platform pages remain source evidence unless formal metadata is verified.

prompts.purpose: Before translation or polishing, bind the output to LaTeX, Word, DOCX, or plain text so escaping, command preservation, Markdown avoidance, and back-translation checks do not drift.
failure_modes: LaTeX output loses commands or special-character escaping
Word output contains Markdown, code fences, or LaTeX escaping
translation improves fluency by changing claim strength
evaluation_notes: Derived from Leey21/awesome-ai-research-writing at commit c07628b.
The prompt pattern is an adapter; local citation and writing gates still control final delivery.

prompts.purpose: Keep small edits small: preserve facts, variables, results, citations, uncertainty, and boundaries, and emit a delta log instead of silently rewriting the argument.
failure_modes: small shorten request deletes evidence or constraints
expand request invents rationale, data, or citations
humanization changes the claim instead of only the surface
evaluation_notes: Applies when the user asks for 缩写, 扩写, 轻度润色, or 去 AI 味.
If structure is broken, route to argument repair instead of pretending it is a micro edit.

prompts.scope: change of conference, journal transfer, or resubmission
prompts.purpose: Treat 改投 and 换会议 as a package migration task that maps target requirements before changing templates, text, figures, references, or submission files.
failure_modes: template changed but target checklist, page limits, or ethics/data requirements ignored
substantive manuscript changes mixed with mechanical format migration
new venue requirements marked ready without evidence
evaluation_notes: The package is not ready until citation, writing, peer-review, figure-table, reproducibility, and freeze checks are satisfied as applicable.
Target-specific facts must be supplied by the user or verified from official instructions before final migration.

prompts.purpose: Convert project friction into an evolution event with source, severity, target, controller, gates, status, and rollback.
failure_modes: durable lesson stored only in chat
skill changed without retrospective signal
adaptation cannot be reverted
evaluation_notes: envctl validate governance must pass after backlog changes.
Status stays observed unless the corresponding schema, validator, doc, or automation actually changed.
